basic_details.job_title: Foreigners Tribunal No. 5 Morigaon Data Entry Operator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Office of the Member, Foreigners Tribunal No. 5, Morigaon, under the Government of Assam, is filling 1 (one) post of Data Entry Operator (DEO) on a purely contractual basis at a fixed pay of Rs. 10,000/- per month. Eligible Indian citizens must send their application in the Standard Form (Assam Gazette Part-IX) so that it reaches the office on or before 7 December 2026, up to 12:00 Noon. The address is Office of the Member, Foreigners Tribunal No. 5, Morigaon, Ward No. 5, Gohaingaon, Morigaon-782105.

content_sections.heading: About Foreigners Tribunal No. 5 Morigaon
content_sections.text: Foreigners Tribunal No. 5 is a Government of Assam office in Morigaon district, located at Ward No. 5, Gohaingaon, Morigaon-782105. The Data Entry Operator post is being filled in pursuance of the Govt. of Assam, Home & Political Department, Political (B) Branch Letter No. PLB60/2020/342 dated 16.03.2022. The selected candidate will work in the office of the Member of the Tribunal.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be made in the Standard Form (Assam Gazette Part-IX) , duly filled, along with the prescribed supporting documents. It must reach this address on or before 7 December 2026, up to 12:00 Noon: Office of the Member, Foreigners Tribunal No. 5, Morigaon, Ward No. 5, Gohaingaon, Morigaon-782105 Fill in the Standard Form (Assam Gazette Part-IX). Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed under Enclosures below. Attach two recent passport-size colour photographs, signed on the reverse side. Write a valid mobile number and e-mail ID on the application. If presently employed, attach a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer or organisation. Send or deliver the application so that it reaches the office by 7 December 2026, 12:00 Noon. The notice does not prescribe a particular postal mode or any wording for the envelope. Incomplete applications, or applications without the prescribed supporting documents, are liable to be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The single post is Data Entry Operator , 1 vacancy, at a fixed pay of Rs. 10,000/- per month. Nationality: The candidate must be a citizen of India. Educational qualification: Higher Secondary (10+2) passed in any stream with minimum 6 (Six) months Diploma/Certificate in Computer Application from any Govt. recognized institution. Computer skill: Good working knowledge of office software tools. Employment Exchange: Candidates must possess valid Employment Exchange Registration. Age limit: As per the existing Government policy. The notice does not print the number of years or an "as on" date. Age relaxation: Admissible relaxation in the upper age limit for OBC/MOBC and SC/ST candidates, as applicable. The notice does not state the number of years of relaxation. Preference: Preference shall be given to candidates who share their home district/local address with the Foreigners Tribunal office where applied for. Experience: Not required as a condition; an experience certificate is to be attached if any. The post is purely temporary and contractual in nature, on fixed pay of Rs. 10,000/- per month, for a fixed period, and subject to approval of the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India, from time to time. The selected candidate shall have no claim for regularization or appointment against any permanent Government post. Refer to the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Duly filled Standard Form (Assam Gazette Part-IX) Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates/mark sheets Computer Diploma/Certificate Course certificate (minimum 6 months) Age proof Address proof Valid Employment Exchange Registration Certificate Experience certificate, if any Two (2) recent passport-size colour photographs, duly signed on the reverse side Valid mobile number and E-mail ID (furnished with the application) No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer, for candidates presently working in any organisation/office

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection consists of a Computer Proficiency Test and an Interview (Viva-Voce) . Applications received within the stipulated period will be scrutinised, and a list of eligible candidates shortlisted for the test and interview will be published on the Notice Board of the office. Only shortlisted candidates will be allowed to appear in the Computer Proficiency Test and Interview (Viva-Voce). The selection process is scheduled for 16 December 2026 from 10 am at the Office of the Member, Foreigners Tribunal No. 5, Morigaon, Ward No. 5, Gohaingaon, Morigaon-782105. Late reporting may result in non-acceptance of candidature. Original certificates/documents must be produced at the time of document verification and will be returned after verification. The candidate securing the highest aggregate marks will be recommended for selection against the single vacant post.

rows.details: Foreigners Tribunal No. 5 Morigaon Data Entry Operator advertisement

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Foreigners Tribunal No. 5 Morigaon Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 (one) vacant post of Data Entry Operator (DEO), filled on a purely contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Office of the Member, Foreigners Tribunal No. 5, Morigaon on or before 7 December 2026, up to 12:00 Noon.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: Higher Secondary (10+2) passed in any stream with a minimum 6 (Six) months Diploma/Certificate in Computer Application from any Govt. recognized institution, and good working knowledge of office software tools.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is as per the existing Government policy, with admissible relaxation in the upper age limit for OBC/MOBC and SC/ST candidates, as applicable.

faq.question: Q5. Who gets age relaxation?
faq.answer: OBC/MOBC and SC/ST candidates get admissible relaxation in the upper age limit, as applicable under the existing Government policy.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the Data Entry Operator?
faq.answer: The post carries a fixed pay of Rs. 10,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the Standard Form (Assam Gazette Part-IX), attach the prescribed self-attested documents and two signed photographs, and make sure it reaches Office of the Member, Foreigners Tribunal No. 5, Morigaon, Ward No. 5, Gohaingaon, Morigaon-782105 by 7 December 2026, 12:00 Noon.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process and when is it held?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates take a Computer Proficiency Test and an Interview (Viva-Voce) on 16 December 2026 from 10 am; the candidate with the highest aggregate marks is recommended for selection.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Data Entry Operator job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely temporary and contractual, for a fixed period, and the selected candidate has no claim for regularization or appointment against any permanent Government post.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for attending the test and interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA or official accommodation will be provided to candidates for attending the recruitment process.
